description: Dynamique du trait de côte normand et picard - WMS - Haute-Normandie - Picardie is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by maps.rolnp.fr. The monitoring of the evolution of the Haut-Norman coast is defined for the period 1966-1995. it corresponds to an average per section expressed in centimeters. (Costa & al., 2000 in CPIBP). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Dynamics of the Normandy and Picardy coastline - WMS - Haute-Normandie - Picardie" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include dynamique littorale, Costa, GEOPHEN, falaise, trait de côte. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
